verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's docs describe selectable workflows (Oneshot, RPI, PRD-Oriented, Freeform) with review points, and say that unclear changes need more review before implementation. Reviewers can also comment on synced task documents. This implies plan review ahead of coding, but no explicit plan-approval gate is documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that an implementation plan is produced and must be approved before code changes, a description of the approval mechanism, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review and approve an agent's implementation plan before any code changes are made

citations.quote: A change with unclear behavior or code shape needs more review before implementation.
Select the shortest workflow that gives you the review points you need.
Reviewers can comment on synced documents in HumanLayer
